name: Gears of War: E-Day — DLSS 4.5 and RTX Mega Geometry (first shipped game)
company: NVIDIA (feature shipped in The Coalition's Gears of War: E-Day)
summary: NVIDIA states Gears of War: E-Day is the first shipped game to support RTX Mega Geometry, letting it ray-trace its full-detail Unreal Engine 5 Nanite geometry instead of a simplified proxy mesh, alongside the full DLSS 4.5 feature set.
